@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Sean got a haircut and started wearing fashionable clothes. It was a huge t______n.
= transformation
~詞義 transformation（n.）轉變
~原文 Sean got a haircut and started wearing fashionable clothes. It was a huge transformation.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Teresa works as a clerk at the department store's information desk. Her job is to answer customers' i______ries.
= inquiries
~詞義 inquiry（n.）詢問
~原文 Teresa works as a clerk at the department store's information desk. Her job is to answer customers' inquiries.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The dog at the airport s______fed the suitcases and immediately identified the one that contained the drugs.
= sniffed
~詞義 sniff（v.）嗅
~原文 The dog at the airport sniffed the suitcases and immediately identified the one that contained the drugs.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The teacher drew a v______l line down the blackboard to divide it into two parts.
= vertical
~詞義 vertical（adj.）垂直的
~原文 The teacher drew a vertical line down the blackboard to divide it into two parts.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Tim did not drink any alcohol tonight. He was the only s______r person, so he drove everyone home.
= sober
~詞義 sober（adj.）清醒的
~原文 Tim did not drink any alcohol tonight. He was the only sober person, so he drove everyone home.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: That is definitely the most ______ story I have ever heard. I cannot believe that it actually happened.
A: ample
B: bizarre
C: compact
D: comparable
= B
~詞義 bizarre（adj.）怪誕的
~原文 That is definitely the most bizarre story I have ever heard. I cannot believe that it actually happened.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ of carbon dioxide is composed of one carbon atom and two oxygen atoms.
A: enterprise
B: franchise
C: molecule
D: premium
= C
~詞義 molecule（n.）分子
~原文 The molecule of carbon dioxide is composed of one carbon atom and two oxygen atoms.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The missing woman is ______ dead. The police can find no trace of her for more than two years.
A: softened
B: compelled
C: presumed
D: prevailed
= C
~詞義 presume（v.）推測
~原文 The missing woman is presumed dead. The police can find no trace of her for more than two years.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The villagers waited in ______ as the storm destroyed their crops, leaving them uncertain about the coming season.
A: criterion
B: despair
C: prejudice
D: veteran
= B
~詞義 despair（n.）絕望
~原文 The villagers waited in despair as the storm destroyed their crops, leaving them uncertain about the coming season.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Lisa can travel to her office either by bus or by MRT. She ______ between these two forms of transportation.
A: alternates
B: derives
C: moans
D: proclaims
= A
~詞義 alternate（v.）輪流
~原文 Lisa can travel to her office either by bus or by MRT. She alternates between these two forms of transportation.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: installation
B: amendment
C: compensated
D: descended
E: vicious
F: versus

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The restaurant ______ the customers for the delay by offering discounts on future purchases.
= C
~詞義 compensate（v.）補償
~原文 The restaurant compensated the customers for the delay by offering discounts on future purchases.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The elevator ______ to the basement and stopped there.
= D
~詞義 descend（v.）下降
~原文 The elevator descended to the basement and stopped there.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Don't believe the scandal you heard from Debbie. What she said was a(n) ______ lie.
= E
~詞義 vicious（adj.）惡毒的
~原文 Don't believe the scandal you heard from Debbie. What she said was a(n) vicious lie.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: A: Who played in the football game? B: It was England ______ Germany.
= F
~詞義 versus（prep.）對上
~原文 A: Who played in the football game? B: It was England versus Germany.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: After a long discussion, the council finally approved the ______, with the hope that it would create a fairer legal process.
= B
~詞義 amendment（n.）修正案
~原文 After a long discussion, the council finally approved the amendment, with the hope that it would create a fairer legal process.

@bank

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: This is the best offer you are likely to get. You would be ______ to reject it.
= C
~詞義 insane（adj.）瘋狂的
~原文 This is the best offer you are likely to get. You would be insane to reject it.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: We have a general ______ for the project, but there are still a lot of details to be discussed.
= F
~詞義 framework（n.）框架
~原文 We have a general framework for the project, but there are still a lot of details to be discussed.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The white ______ on the kitchen wall are covered in oil stains. They have not been cleaned for a long time.
= A
~詞義 tile（n.）磁磚
~原文 The white tiles on the kitchen wall are covered in oil stains. They have not been cleaned for a long time.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Wendy and her husband first met on a plane. They both think it must have been ______ that they happened to sit next to each other.
= D
~詞義 destiny（n.）命運
~原文 Wendy and her husband first met on a plane. They both think it must have been destiny that they happened to sit next to each other.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Fast-food consumption is ______ among teenagers, which raises concerns about long-term health effects and lifestyle habits.
= E
~詞義 prevalent（adj.）普遍的
~原文 Fast-food consumption is prevalent among teenagers, which raises concerns about long-term health effects and lifestyle habits.
